days.title: Arrival in Dublin
days.desc: Welcome to Dublin, Ireland's vibrant capital city. Begin your journey with a private transfer from Dublin airport to your hotel. Immerse yourself in Dublin's rich history, lively atmosphere, and friendly culture.
days.taste: A pint of stout and a bowl of Irish stew at a traditional Dublin pub.

days.title: Dublin
days.desc: Explore Dublin at your pace with a one-day Hop-On Hop-Off ticket, offering access to iconic landmarks and attractions. Discover the city's heritage and contemporary charm.
days.fallbackIncluded: Guinness Storehouse standard experience with a pint
days.experience: Temple Bar’s cobbled lanes and traditional live-music pubs come alive after dark.

days.title: Dublin to Limerick
days.desc: Travel by train to Limerick along the scenic River Shannon. Explore historic sites like King John's Castle. Wander through vibrant streets, such as O'Connell Street, and embrace the city's warm hospitality. Limerick, known as the "City of Culture," beckons with its rich heritage.
days.experience: The train follows the River Shannon, Ireland’s longest river, for much of the journey.

days.title: Limerick
days.desc: Embark on a captivating 7-hour coach tour from Limerick to the stunning Cliffs of Moher, showcasing Ireland's natural beauty. Enjoy the breathtaking views and coastal splendour.
days.experience: A jaunting-car ride through Killarney National Park with a local driver.

days.title: Limerick
days.desc: Enjoy a day at leisure in Limerick. Opt for optional tours to the picturesque Ring of Kerry or the scenic Dingle Peninsula, or explore Limerick's local attractions.
days.fallbackIncluded: Ring of Kerry Full day Tour | Dingle Peninsula Full day Tour
days.taste: The Milk Market in Limerick for farmhouse cheese and freshly baked soda bread.

days.title: Limerick to Dublin
days.desc: Travel by train from Limerick back to Dublin for your final night in the Irish capital. Reflect on your Irish adventures in Dublin.
days.shopping: Kilkenny Design Centre, in the castle’s old stables, for Irish craft and knitwear.

days.title: Limerick to Dublin
days.desc: Conclude your tour with a private transfer from your Dublin hotel to the airport. Depart with fond memories of Ireland's beauty and hospitality.

days.title: Arrival in Dublin
days.desc: Land at Dublin Airport and collect your rental car, embracing the freedom of a self-drive adventure through Ireland's scenic landscapes. Dublin, Ireland's capital, beckons with its historic landmarks, vibrant culture, and the potential for explorations across the Emerald Isle.
days.taste: A pint of stout and a bowl of Irish stew at a traditional Dublin pub.

days.title: Dublin
days.desc: Explore Dublin's splendour with a panoramic self-drive around the city, encompassing renowned landmarks like Trinity College, St. Patrick's Cathedral, and the lively streets of Temple Bar. Revel in the city's allure, visiting historic districts and charming areas at your leisure.
days.fallbackIncluded: Guinness Storehouse standard experience with a pint
days.experience: Temple Bar’s cobbled lanes and traditional live-music pubs come alive after dark.

days.title: Dublin to Limerick
days.desc: Depart Dublin for Limerick with a stop at the breathtaking Cliffs of Moher. These majestic cliffs, standing tall along the Atlantic coast, offer awe-inspiring views. Arrive in Limerick, a city rich in history and home to landmarks like King John's Castle.
days.experience: The train follows the River Shannon, Ireland’s longest river, for much of the journey.

days.title: Limerick
days.desc: Embark on a self-drive excursion from Limerick to Killarney, an enchanting town nestled in the heart of the scenic Ring of Kerry. Explore Killarney National Park, Muckross House, and the stunning landscapes along the route, renowned for their natural beauty. Return to Limerick by evening.
days.experience: A jaunting-car ride through Killarney National Park with a local driver.

days.title: Limerick
days.desc: Explore Doolin's enchanting coastal village before journeying to the scenic Dingle Peninsula. Discover Slea Head Drive's stunning vistas, visit quaint villages like Dingle, and admire scenic stops along the way. Return to Limerick in the evening.
days.taste: The Milk Market in Limerick for farmhouse cheese and freshly baked soda bread.

days.title: Limerick to Dublin
days.desc: Depart from Limerick towards Dublin, with a stop in Kilkenny. Explore Kilkenny's medieval charm, visit the historic Kilkenny Castle, and enjoy the scenic route with possible stops at places like Rock of Cashel or Glendalough. Continue your journey to Dublin.
days.shopping: Kilkenny Design Centre, in the castle’s old stables, for Irish craft and knitwear.

days.title: Limerick to Dublin
days.desc: Conclude your self-drive adventure by returning the rental car at Dublin Airport rental office. Depart with cherished memories of Ireland's stunning landscapes and vibrant cities.

about.title: Best season
about.body: May–September for long days; shoulder months quieter and better value

about.title: Weather
about.body: Mild and changeable. 12–20°C in summer. Pack a rain layer year-round

goodToKnow.title: Best season
goodToKnow.body: April–September for long days and best weather; shoulder months quieter and often better value.

goodToKnow.title: Currency & documents
goodToKnow.body: England/Scotland use £ GBP. Ireland uses € EUR. Both are Schengen-free — check your entry requirements.

goodToKnow.title: What to pack
goodToKnow.body: Layers and a waterproof in any month. Comfortable shoes for cobbles and coastal paths.

goodToKnow.title: Driving
goodToKnow.body: Drive on the left. Rural roads can be narrow — allow extra time. Petrol stations sparse in Highland areas.

goodToKnow.title: Rail travel
goodToKnow.body: Seat reservations are included on inter-city trains. Arrive 10 minutes before departure.

goodToKnow.title: Your vehicle
goodToKnow.body: Driver hours are limited to 10 hrs/day by law. Luggage space fits one large case per guest.

terms: All rates are net and per person for the package.

Child rates apply for children aged from 2 to 11 years old. 1 child sharing a room with 2 adults (depending on hotel policy). If the hotel doesn’t have availability for family rooms, adult rates will apply.
All rates are subject to availability at the time of booking. Europe Incoming will endeavour to match the rates quoted in the packages.
Rates quoted are not applicable during trade fair periods, major European Holidays and other major events.
City taxes are not included in the price.
If certain entrances are closed during certain periods, alternative entrances will be provided.
All bookings have to be confirmed at least 60 working days prior to arrival date by the Agent. Early bookings increase the chances of achieving the quoted package rate.
The prices we quote are indicative, but we always try to confirm the prices offered in this document.
We require 100% pre-payment either by bank transfer or by credit card (VISA or Mastercard). All charges for bank transfers need to be covered by the Agent.
Vouchers will be issued after receipt of the full payment in our bank account.
